job: Opens the installed OpenAI and Anthropic Discord presence controls, with a manual setup checklist.
runs_on: Modern browser for the pet interface; original application requirements remain in README.md.

submit.job: Puts Astra's live AI work on her Discord profile: the OpenAI and Anthropic Discord Presence tools show the model in use and every active project, taking turns every 6 seconds.

built_with: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6), 2026-10-08; homepage (its pet program page) added with Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-10-19

audit.subject: the OpenAI and Anthropic presence apps
audit.needs: Discord open with activity sharing on

tools.name: openai-discord-presence
tools.label: discord-tower-v1.0-openai-discord-presence-v0.2
tools.intended_use: Shows the OpenAI model, effort and active Codex projects on Discord. Reads Codex metadata read-only; names a chat by its user-given name, then its folder, then its saved Codex project.
tools.runs_on: Windows, this PC only (control page http://127.0.0.1:38761/)

tools.name: anthropic-discord-presence
tools.label: discord-tower-v1.0-anthropic-discord-presence-v0.2
tools.intended_use: Shows the Anthropic model, effort and active Claude Code projects on Discord. Reads Claude Code transcript metadata only; names a session by its /rename name, then its folder. Always on covers Claude on the web and desktop chat.
tools.runs_on: Windows, this PC only (control page http://127.0.0.1:38762/)

tools.name: sticker-manager
tools.label: discord-tower-v1.0-sticker-manager-v1.0
tools.intended_use: Shows every Discord server Astra is in, each opening to its stickers, and resets her favorite stickers to the ones she picks, after she confirms. Reads the Discord app's own server, sticker and favorites lists; changes only the favorite stickers, through Discord's own settings saver. No requests of its own, no token.
tools.runs_on: Discord desktop with BetterDiscord (third-party), this PC only

tools.name: cli-proxy-api
tools.label: discord-tower-v1.0-cli-proxy-api-v1.0
tools.intended_use: Looks after CLI Proxy API, a third-party program: installs only the verified v8.0.34 from quarantine, writes a config that keeps it on 127.0.0.1 with plugins and discovery off, and starts and stops it from a control page on this PC. Refuses to start with a Claude sign-in in its folder. Never signs anything in; Start is Astra's click.
tools.runs_on: Windows, this PC only (controls http://127.0.0.1:38763/, proxy and console http://127.0.0.1:8317/)

programs.name: dm-archive-review
programs.label: discord-tower-v1.0-dm-archive-v0.1
programs.intended_use: Read user-selected DiscordChatExporter JSON and media locally without changing messages or timestamp strings. Check counts and media presence; cannot prove a complete Discord history.
programs.data: User-selected files outside the repository; read in this browser tab only.
